title: LAP4: first new glovebox is installed, but acceptance and attributable output remain open
publisher: U.S. Department of Energy, National Nuclear Security Administration
summary: NNSA reported in March 2024 that LAP4 was removing contaminated material and had installed its first new glovebox; later planning records continue to separate equipment installation from complete subproject baselines and production capability. Denominator: The first new glovebox installed within the LAP4 modernization effort, bounded from the broader 30-pits-per-year planning objective.
key_findings: Finding: NNSA reported in March 2024 that LAP4 was removing contaminated material and had installed its first new glovebox; later planning records continue to separate equipment installation from complete subproject baselines and production capability.
